original_sentence: Flippy was created by Miso Robotics, part of the Cali Group, which is described by its CEO, John Miller, as: "A technology company that happens to sell cheeseburgers."
translation: Flippy 由 Miso Robotics 创造，该公司隶属于 Cali Group；其首席执行官 John Miller 将 Cali Group 描述为“一家碰巧卖芝士汉堡的科技公司”。
